name: Question 4
problem:
The region $R$ is enclosed inside the cylinder ${x}^{2}+{y}^{2}=1$ between the surfaces $z=0$ and $z=1.$ Express the following triple integral in cylindrical polar coordinates. 

$$
{∭}_{R}{z}^{2}\sqrt{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}\,\text{d}V
$$
